title: Bypassing Key Management Systems
pattern: Exposing raw cryptographic private keys, passphrases, or tokens as plaintext strings inside application configuration structures.
why_bad: Significantly broadens the blast radius of a credential compromise. Any debugging dump, heap scan, or logged configuration error leaks active administrative secrets.
detection: Public API or struct fields holding un-encrypted private key strings or plaintext credentials instead of abstract handles.
fix: Accept only abstract resource names or key identifiers; delegate decryption and credential loading entirely to a dedicated Key Management Service (KMS) or secure agent.
source: Heather Adkins et al., - *Building Secure and Reliable Systems* (2020, O'Reilly Media).pdf, Chapter 5.
